name: lem-harmonic-affine-bridge
source: imports validated registry lemma proofs/lem-harmonic-affine-bridge — Harmonic-affine bridge: for an exact signed idempotent P with rows p_i = (P_ij)_j, a vector g satisfies Pg = g if and only if there exists u with g_i = u . p_i for every row index i; in the forward direction u = g works (g_i = p_i . g), and the constant term of any affine representation is absorbable into u since all row sums equal 1.
